tips.title: Before your ID photo
tips.lead: Four things to know so the photo is accepted, and so you like how you look in it.

items.title: Keep your face clear
items.text: Head uncovered, forehead and eyes fully visible. Tuck back or tie up any hair that falls across your face.

items.title: A neutral expression
items.text: Mouth closed, looking straight at the lens. It's not the moment for a big smile, but you can still look relaxed.

items.title: Glasses: better without
items.text: They're allowed if there are no reflections or tinted lenses. The safest option is to take them off for the photo.

items.title: A recent photo
items.text: It must be less than six months old and look like you. An old photo can get the application rejected.

items.q: Do I need an appointment for an ID photo?
items.a: No. ID photos are walk-in during the studio's opening hours: Tuesday to Friday 9:30am to 7pm, Saturday 9:30am to 6pm. Baby, family and portrait sessions are booked ahead.

items.q: Are your ID photos accepted for a French passport or identity card?
items.a: Yes. Photos are taken to the official French standards (35 × 45 mm, plain light background, face-on, neutral expression) and checked before we hand them over. For an online driving-licence application, ask for an e-photo with a code and digital signature.

items.q: What are the studio's opening hours?
items.a: Affinités Photos is open Tuesday to Friday from 9:30am to 7pm and Saturday from 9:30am to 6pm. The studio is closed on Sunday and Monday.

items.q: How quickly will I get my photos?
items.a: An ID photo is ready on the spot, in a few minutes. For prints, enlargements and session photos, we tell you the turnaround when you order.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Payment is made at the studio. If you're unsure about a payment method, call us on 03 22 91 60 34 before you come.

items.q: Where is the studio and where can I park?
items.a: At 5 rue de la Hotoie, 80000 Amiens, a few minutes' walk from the city centre. You can park on the street and in neighbouring streets.

identite.metaDescription: Walk-in ID photos in Amiens: French identity card, passport, driving licence (ANTS e-photo), residence permit, visas. Ready in a few minutes at 5 rue de la Hotoie.
identite.title: ID photos in Amiens
identite.intro: Affinités Photos takes your ID photos at 5 rue de la Hotoie, with no appointment, Tuesday to Saturday. Every photo is framed and checked against the official standards before we hand it over: you leave with it a few minutes later.

sections.title: For which documents?
sections.text: French identity card, passport, driving licence, residence permit, health card, travel pass, and the formats other countries require for a visa or a foreign passport.

sections.title: The e-photo for driving licences
sections.text: To apply for a French driving licence online on the ANTS website, you need a digital photo with a code and your signature. Ask for an e-photo: the code is valid for six months.

sections.title: Babies and children
sections.text: The rules are a little more relaxed for the very young, but the photo is still tricky to get right. We take our time and try again as often as needed.

identite.rulesLead: The official rules for a French ID photo, in short.

rules.v: Face-on, 32 to 36 mm from chin to crown
Plain and light (light grey or blue), never white
Uncovered: no hat, scarf or headband

how.title: Come when it suits you
how.text: No appointment, during opening hours. Tell us which document the photo is for.

how.title: We take the photo
how.text: A few tries if needed, until the photo is compliant, and you're happy with it.

how.title: You leave with it
how.text: Your printed photos, or your e-photo with its code, in a few minutes.

bebe.title: Baby and newborn photographer in Amiens
bebe.intro: Affinités Photos welcomes newborns, babies and their families at its studio at 5 rue de la Hotoie, Amiens. Calm sessions that follow the child's pace, to keep a record of those first months that go by so fast.

steps.title: We talk beforehand
steps.text: By phone or at the studio: the baby's age, what you have in mind, who will be in the photos. We set the day and time together.

steps.title: On the day
steps.text: You arrive with no pressure. We stop for a bottle, a feed or a cuddle as often as needed.

steps.title: You choose your images
steps.text: We show you the photos and you choose the ones you keep, as prints or enlargements.

sections.title: Newborn
sections.text: The first few weeks are the best time: babies sleep a lot and can be settled gently. Book before the birth if you can; we adjust the date afterwards.

sections.title: The first months
sections.text: The first smile, sitting up, the first birthday: each stage suits a session, alone or with the family.

sections.title: Maternity and family
sections.text: Before the baby arrives, or all together once they're here: big brothers, big sisters and grandparents are welcome.

bebe.closing: The first months don't come back. The photos stay.
